clues: This city stands on the west bank of a big river in the heart of Argentina. It lies far northwest of the great capital, Buenos Aires.
This city is often much warmer than the farms around it. Its flat land, its river bank, and its dense built streets make a small heat trap.
In 2003, a new bridge opened across the big river here. It joined this city to one more city across the wide river delta.
Lionel Messi was born in this city. He is one of the most loved football stars on Earth.
Its streets hold hundreds of fine old homes and public halls. They were built in grand old styles, like Art Deco and Art Nouveau.
